editorial:
Imagine living in a quiet, pretty island town where nothing ever happens, until one day a dead body and a million dollars in cash show up at the same time. That is exactly how things kick off here. You get to meet a group of quirky locals who are all just a little bit desperate. Instead of doing the right thing and calling the police, these people start making the worst choices possible to get their hands on the money. It feels like a chaotic game of musical chairs where everyone is lying to each other, and the vibe is a perfect mix of a dark comedy and a crime puzzle.

What really works is how the tension builds as the characters get more greedy and paranoid. The acting is great because you actually enjoy watching these flawed people mess up their lives. While some of the plot twists are a bit predictable, the fast pace keeps you glued to the screen. If you love movies where a simple situation spirals out of control, you should definitely check this out. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: In the end, the greed completely destroys the town's peace. After a series of betrayals and lies, the money causes more harm than good. The final twist reveals that the pursuit of wealth was a trap that exposed everyone's true, ugly nature. Most of the characters end up losing everything they cared about, proving that the money was cursed. It wraps up with a dark irony, showing that nobody truly wins when everyone is selfish.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedies and crime mysteries with a twist.
